Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results, incorrectly stating that Charles Mingus was from Los Angeles, California, even though the sources clearly indicated he was born in Nogales, Arizona. This misread conflated “raised in Los Angeles” with birthplace, shifting the chain to the wrong state (California) and the wrong target race (Long Beach) instead of Arizona’s largest city (Phoenix) and its 1993 IndyCar race, whose winner was Mario Andretti.
